newsitem.title: UK: Tesco off, BZW says switch to Safeway.
newsitem.headline: Tesco off, BZW says switch to Safeway.

text.p: Tesco Plc shares fell 10p to 372p after BZW issued a cautious note on the British food retailers, dealers said.
"The shares have had a good run and the next bit of news might be disappointing," said BZW analyst David McCarthy.

"The last time we heard from them, food price inflation was one percent and we are now experiencing one percent deflation - a loss of two percent. Sales might have eased off and the market has not taken this into account," he said.
McCarthy said Tesco may produce "slightly disappointing" news at its agm in two weeks time.
"The shares are on a market rating and any bit of bad news might prompt profit-taking," he said.
He recommended switching out of Tesco into Safeway Plc to which Tesco is at a 15 percent premium.
More than seven million Safeway shares changed hands and nearly four million Tesco shares were traded.
